drone_logistics_revolution.name: Drone logistics revolution
drone_logistics_revolution.description: The sky is a truck now: cheap airframes move shells and stretchers to the line nobody drives to.

autonomous_supply_corps.name: Autonomous supply corps
autonomous_supply_corps.description: Convoys that drive themselves over ground no surveyor has walked, and rebuild what shellfire unmakes.

orbital_broadband_boom.name: Orbital broadband boom
orbital_broadband_boom.description: Every valley online at once: provinces that traded by barter trade by wire.

rare_earth_cartel_discipline.name: Rare earth cartel discipline
rare_earth_cartel_discipline.description: The refiners hold the line and the world pays their price for what its magnets need.

nuclear_terror.name: Nuclear terror
nuclear_terror.description: A minute and a half when nobody knew. Everybody who has a capital remembers it.

red_line_treaty.name: The Red Line Treaty
red_line_treaty.description: Signed by every hand that could end the world, with inspections anyone can refuse and nobody has.
